==Walkthrough==
===If you already have the 20 unnoted balls of wool===
{{Checklist|*Talk to [[Fred the Farmer]] north of [[Lumbridge]]. {{Chat option|1I'm looking for a quest.}}
*Fred takes the 20 [[balls of wool]].
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}

===If you don't have the balls of wool===
{{Checklist|*Talk to [[Fred the Farmer]] north of [[Lumbridge]]. {{Chat option|1I'm looking for a quest. |1Yes.}}
**He will give you [[shears]] if you do not have them.
*Enter the sheep pen to the east, connected to his house and shear sheep for 20 [[wool]].
**[[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] Ultimate Ironmen: You can deliver the balls of wool in several trips. You do not have to deliver all 20 at once.
::'''Note:''' You cannot shear [[Ram]]s or "[[The Thing]]". If you attack a ram and cannot kill it, run out of the pen until it stops targeting you.
*Go to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of [[Lumbridge Castle]].
*Click on the [[spinning wheel]] in the southern room to spin the wool.
*With 20 '''un-noted''' [[balls of wool]], return to [[Fred the Farmer]].
*Talk to [[Fred the Farmer]] and hand them in. {{Chat option|1I need to talk to you about shearing these sheep!}}
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
